description: Only the versions.env pins are Renovate-managed; dependabot keeps gomod and github-actions.

customManagers.description: Pins in versions.env annotated with a `# renovate:` comment

packageRules.description: A Trivy patch release is an adapter patch release: release-please parses the squash-merged PR title
prBodyNotes: Re-check `trivy-cve-overrides.txt` against the new tag: `task build:trivy` asserts each audited version on the pristine tag, so a stale entry fails the preview build instead of silently pinning below upstream.

packageRules.description: Anything bigger is an adapter minor release
